description: Review rubric for mnemonic / memory-aid cards (acronyms, songs, stories, image-mnemonics).

criteria.label: Underlying content accuracy
criteria.description: The thing being memorized via the mnemonic is itself correct (e.g. if the mnemonic encodes the order of planets, the order is right).

criteria.label: Memorability
criteria.description: Will a Class 11/12 student remember this after one exposure? Distinctive enough to stick? Rhymes / images / patterns help.

criteria.label: Cultural fit (Indian context)
criteria.description: References make sense to Indian Class 11/12 students. Avoid US-centric or alien references. Bollywood / cricket / mythology references encouraged where natural.

criteria.label: Decoding clarity
criteria.description: Student can decode the mnemonic back into the underlying content without ambiguity.

criteria.label: Tastefulness / safety
criteria.description: No offensive, derogatory, or culturally insensitive content. No mnemonics that rely on stereotypes.

approval_rule: accuracy + tastefulness MUST be 5/5. Other criteria meet minimum_pass.
